name: Gibberifier
description: Right-click selected text to convert it into gibberish using invisible Unicode characters

permissions_justifications.activeTab: Required to access and modify the selected text on the current page when you use the right-click context menu to gibberify text.
permissions_justifications.contextMenus: Required to add a "Gibberify Selected Text" option to the right-click context menu when users select text on any webpage. This provides an easy way for users to trigger the gibberification process.
permissions_justifications.scripting: Required to inject the text processing script into the active tab when you trigger the gibberify action.
